prompt: Subject: A loose shoulder strap. Main Subject: A vertical 2:3 fashion portrait. A woman is sitting alone on a marble windowsill by a bright window, reading a thin open book. The subject is placed slightly to the right of the center, capturing the whole body from head to pumps, occupying about 60% of the image. Large, blurred pale beige fixtures are included on the left, right, and top to create depth as if looking through a gap. Person/Expression: Delicate and smooth skin texture with bright ivory-beige fair skin and a faint pink healthy glow. Soft highlights are placed on the cheeks, tip of the nose, shoulders, collarbones, and front of the legs, leaving slight pores and natural skin texture. The upper body has feminine, mature curves, and the bust is naturally full and three-dimensional. Pale rose blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin eyelashes, natural tear troughs, bright brown eyebrows, and translucent pink-beige lips. The face is tilted toward the bottom left of the screen, quietly looking at the pages of the book with clear eyes, and the mouth has a relaxed, calm expression. The hair is a bright milk tea ash brown. Thin see-through bangs, layers along the face, medium-long length reaching below the shoulders. The ends of the hair are loosely curled inward, flowing softly from the right shoulder to the chest. Carefully depict thin highlights, natural texture, and a small amount of stray hairs. Clothing/Pose: A deep but elegant V-neck camisole combining ivory satin and delicate lace. Only one thin shoulder strap has slipped from the shoulder and is naturally resting on the outside of the upper arm. The other shoulder strap remains in the correct position. The fabric at the chest creates natural tension and fine wrinkles along the body, without over-exposing. The bottom is a beige high-waisted mini skirt with a thin belt at the waist. The upper body is slightly twisted to the left, and both hands support the sides of the open book. Fingertips touch the edges of the pages, expressing the overlapping paper and light curling. Knees are elegantly overlapped and legs are crossed, with the lower leg on the right side extended long and the tip of the foot lightly placed on the seat of the wooden chair in the foreground. The other leg is relaxed and dangles diagonally downward. Ivory pointed-toe pumps with small metallic gold toe decorations. Background/Light: A large window with an old white frame, delicate floral ecru curtains and golden leaf-shaped tassels on the right. Several books are on the left of the windowsill, a small dark wood-grain cabinet at the bottom left, and a classical wooden chair at the bottom right. Outside the window, a reddish-brown wall and railing are shown softly blurred. White diffused daylight enters from the top-left window, brightly illuminating the subject's left cheek, shoulder, chest, arms, and legs. Warm reflected light from the curtains and interior walls is weakly added to the right side, and shadows are cast faintly toward the bottom right. The outside of the window is slightly overexposed in white, and the interior is calmed with ivory and wood colors. Composition/Camera: Vertical orientation, a long-shot portrait including the whole body. The camera is positioned slightly higher than the waist and shot almost horizontally, giving a gentle compression equivalent to 70-85mm. Focus on the face, upper body, and book, while smoothly blurring the foreground fixtures, window exterior, and indoor furniture. Leave wide margins above the head and at the feet including the chair, creating a quiet asymmetrical balance between the bright window on the left and the person on the right. Texture/Style: An indoor photograph for an elegant Japanese fashion magazine. A low-saturation color scheme centered on ivory, pale beige, milk tea brown, and dark wood grain. Realistically express the natural transparency of the skin, the depiction of thin hair, the modest luster of satin, the fine mesh of lace, the thinness of paper, and the aged look of wooden furniture. Soft contrast, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, and a calm finish that is not overly sharp. Negative: Persons who look like minors, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, broken crossed legs, poor contact between shoes and feet, floating, unnatural gravity, clothing penetration, unnatural shoulder strap connection, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, garbled text, logos, watermarks.

promptZh: 主体：一根滑落的肩带。主要对象：垂直 2:3 的时尚肖像。一位女性独自坐在明亮窗前的大理石窗台上，正在阅读一本翻开的薄书。主体位于画面中心偏右位置，呈现从头部到高跟鞋的全身像，占据画面约 60%。左侧、右侧及顶部包含大面积模糊的浅米色装置，营造出仿佛透过缝隙观察的深度感。人物/表情：细腻平滑的皮肤质感，呈现明亮的象牙米色白皙肤色，带有淡淡的粉色健康光泽。脸颊、鼻尖、肩膀、锁骨和腿部前方有柔和的高光，保留了细微的毛孔和自然的皮肤纹理。上半身具有女性成熟的曲线，胸部自然丰满且立体。淡玫瑰色腮红，香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，长而纤细的睫毛，自然的卧蚕，明亮的棕色眉毛，以及半透明的粉米色嘴唇。脸部朝屏幕左下方倾斜，双眼清澈，静静地注视着书页，嘴部表情放松而平静。发色为明亮的奶茶灰棕色。稀疏的透视刘海，脸部周围有层次感，中长发长度及肩。发梢向内微卷，从右肩柔和地垂落至胸前。细致描绘纤细的高光、自然的质感以及少许碎发。服装/姿势：一件结合了象牙色缎面与精致蕾丝的深 V 领吊带衫。其中一根细肩带从肩膀滑落，自然地搭在上臂外侧。另一根肩带保持在正确位置。胸前的面料顺着身体线条产生自然的张力和细微褶皱，不过分暴露。下身穿着米色高腰迷你裙，腰间系有细腰带。上半身略微向左扭转，双手支撑着打开的书页两侧。指尖触碰书页边缘，表现出纸张的重叠感与轻微卷曲。双膝优雅重叠，双腿交叠，右侧小腿向外延伸，脚尖轻放在前景的木椅座面上。另一条腿放松地向斜下方垂下。象牙色尖头高跟鞋，鞋头带有小巧的金色金属装饰。背景/光影：一扇带有旧白色边框的大窗户，右侧配有精致的碎花本白色窗帘和金色叶形流苏。窗台左侧放着几本书，左下方有一个小型深色木纹柜，右下方有一把古典木椅。窗外可见红棕色墙壁和栏杆，呈现柔和模糊状。白色的漫射日光从左上方窗户射入，明亮地照亮了主体的左脸颊、肩膀、胸部、手臂和腿部。来自窗帘和室内墙壁的暖色反射光微弱地补充在右侧，阴影淡淡地投向右下方。窗外光线略微过曝呈白色，室内则以象牙色和木色调营造出宁静感。构图/相机：垂直构图，包含全身的长焦肖像。相机位置略高于腰部，几乎水平拍摄，产生相当于 70-85mm 镜头的柔和压缩感。焦点集中在脸部、上半身和书本上，同时平滑地虚化前景装置、窗外景色和室内家具。头部上方和包含椅子的脚部下方留有宽裕的留白，在左侧明亮的窗户与右侧的人物之间形成宁静的非对称平衡。质感/风格：优雅日本时尚杂志的室内摄影风格。以象牙色、浅米色、奶茶棕色和深木纹为中心的低饱和度配色方案。真实地表现皮肤的自然通透感、细发描绘、缎面的内敛光泽、蕾丝的细密网格、纸张的轻薄感以及木质家具的岁月感。柔和的对比度、浅景深、细腻的胶片颗粒感，整体呈现出不过分锐化的沉稳质感。负面提示：看起来像未成年人、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、腿部交叉处断裂、鞋子与脚部接触不良、悬浮、不自然的重力、衣物穿模、肩带连接不自然、透视错误、阴影与光源不一致、塑料质感皮肤、过度磨皮、乱码文字、Logo、水印。
